request.spec:
Work out for me whether an invoice is paid, part paid or still owing. Base it on the payments
I have recorded. I do not want to flip it to paid by hand anymore.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Work out for me whether an invoice is paid, part paid or still owing. Base it on the payments
I have recorded. I do not want to flip it to paid by hand anymore.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
All clean — those are the `onPaymentRecorded` callback, not the removed manual-pay button. The test passes.

## Summary

I implemented invoice status as a value **derived from recorded payments** instead of a field flipped by hand, as a full-stack additive change.

**Database:** No migration needed — the `payments` table (V23) and seed support already exist.

**Server** (`src/main/java/.../invoices/`):
- `InvoiceService.java` — the `InvoiceView` row mapper now derives `status` from the amounts via a new `deriveStatus(...)` helper: **PAID** once payments cover the amount, **PARTIAL** once some (but not all) is paid, otherwise the stored lifecycle status (DRAFT/SENT). Added a public `get(invoiceId)` for a single invoice.
- `addPayment(...)` now records the audit line in the format the spec reads: `PAYMENT_RECORDED id=<paymentId> amount=<amount>` (using the saved payment's id).
- New `InvoiceLogic.java` + `rest/api/invoices/{invoiceId}.GET.yml` — a `GET /api/invoices/{invoiceId}` endpoint returning the invoice (with its derived status).

**Front-end** (`src/main/frontend/features/projects/`):
- `InvoiceLineItems.tsx` — fetches the invoice and renders `data-testid="invoice-status"`; re-reads it when a payment is recorded (and when line items change).
- `InvoicePayments.tsx` — calls an `onPaymentRecorded` callback after a successful payment so the status refreshes.
- `ProjectDetail.tsx` — removed the manual "Mark paid" button and its handler ("I do not want to flip it to paid by hand anymore"); the project row's `invoice-status` now reflects the derived status.

`bin/e2e` passes (1/1).

Note: the old `POST /api/invoices/{invoiceId}/pay` endpoint is left in place but is no longer wired to any UI, keeping the change local and additive. I can remove that endpoint too if you'd prefer it fully gone.
